attempt1: Propose the full overdue amount (or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week, or of next week if today is that day, capped at the deadline.

prompts.phone_last4: What are the last 4 digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

opening.text: This is the digital assistant calling from Lumen Bank; this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you pay the full overdue amount?

first_ask_multi.text: Let us start with the first product: can you pay the full overdue amount?

ai.text: I am Lumen Bank's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this by phoning Lumen Bank's customer service number.

failed_id.text: Please use the mobile app or a branch.

paid_reply.text: A payment may take one business day to show, so I will not record a promise.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed during this call.

cannot_record.text: I cannot record an amount below the minimum amount.

id_reason.text: The security questions protect your account.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Could you tell me the month as a word?

ask_again.text: Sorry, could you confirm: am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirm identity; 'hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this' do not. Answer the customer's question first, ask at most twice, then close 65-NR-UNC.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "hello", "go ahead", "who is this" are not.

extra_rules.statement: Before security passes, say nothing about collections, debt, payment or the product, to anyone.
extra_rules.brief_quote: No mention of collections, debt, payment or the product before security passes - to anyone.

extra_rules.statement: With a non-customer, say nothing about why you call; ask when the customer can be reached. Relatives may not answer security or hear anything about the account.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Relatives may not answer security or hear anything about the account.

extra_rules.statement: Callback must be today or next business day, 10:00-19:00 inclusive, and later than now; outside window ask once more, then 62-NR-NOCB.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Callback = today or next business day, 10:00-19:00 incl., later than now

extra_rules.statement: Deceased: say only 'I am sorry for your loss.' then close 64-NR-RIP. Wrong number: close 63-NR-WN.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Deceased -> "I am sorry for your loss." only -> 64-NR-RIP

extra_rules.statement: Date of birth is sent as YYYY-MM-DD; a numbers-only date is read as day/month/year. An unreadable date is rejected by the API with ok=false and is not a wrong answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: send YYYY-MM-DD; numbers-only = day/month/year

extra_rules.statement: Verify after each answer; 3 wrong answers in total end the check: say to use the mobile app or a branch, say nothing about the account, close 51-NV-FAIL.
extra_rules.brief_quote: 3 wrong answers in total = end

extra_rules.statement: If hint=day_month_swapped, ask for the month as a word; it is not a wrong answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: hint=day_month_swapped -> ask month as a word; not a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: If customer won't answer security, explain once it protects the account; second refusal or second 'what's this about?' -> 52-NV-DEC.
extra_rules.brief_quote: second refusal or second "what's this about?" -> 52-NV-DEC

extra_rules.statement: After security call get_account, then say the call is from the collections team about a late payment, name the product in words, past_due and days_late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "Calling from the collections team about a late payment", product in words (table B), past_due, days_late.

extra_rules.statement: Promise date must be >= today, a business day, and <= deadline. Weekend/holiday within deadline -> offer next business day; after deadline -> offer the deadline (refusal = flat refusal); vague date -> ask once for exact day, else propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Promise date: >= today, business day, <= deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Ask the full past_due first; never ask 'how much can you pay'. If too much, offer the floor once ('the rest stays overdue'); refusal = flat refusal. Amount between floor and full is accepted; below floor cannot be recorded, offer floor once.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Ask full past_due first; never "how much can you pay".

extra_rules.statement: Customer's own date/amount is never a refusal; flat no or no answer counts as one attempt; never repeat a refused offer; when attempts are used stop -> 41-NP-REF.
extra_rules.brief_quote: customer's own date/amount is never a refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Before recording ask 'Can you make this payment today?' first; read back product, amount, date, ask 'Do you confirm?'; only on a clear yes call create_promise. One promise per product, no changes in-call. Say recorded only on ok:true; on failure retry once, then say not recorded -> 44-NP-ERR.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "Can you make this payment today?" first.

extra_rules.statement: Hardship (illness, death in family, job loss): one sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, offer support team; accept -> transfer support -> 33-TRF-SU; decline -> 42-NP-HS; if customer names own date/amount, record normally.
extra_rules.brief_quote: one sentence of sympathy, NO persuasion, offer support team.

extra_rules.statement: 'Already paid': may take one business day to show; no promise -> 20-PAID. 'Not mine / never had it / closed it': no argument, no promise -> 43-NP-DSP.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "ALREADY PAID" -> may take one business day to show

extra_rules.statement: New plan / lower instalments: give no plan details, transfer to restructuring -> 31-TRF-RS.
extra_rules.brief_quote: NEW PLAN / LOWER INSTALMENTS -> no plan details

extra_rules.statement: Human requested: ask once if you can help; if customer insists transfer to general -> 32-TRF-HU, before or after security.
extra_rules.brief_quote: HUMAN -> ask once if you can help; insists

extra_rules.statement: Customer says twice they don't want to talk -> 41-NP-REF (before security: 52-NV-DEC).
extra_rules.brief_quote: SAYS TWICE "DON'T WANT TO TALK" -> 41-NP-REF

extra_rules.statement: If asked about scam, say to verify by phoning Lumen Bank's customer service number and continue. Unknown info: say you don't have it, never invent. No discounts, waivers or plans.
extra_rules.brief_quote: No discounts / waivers / plans.

extra_rules.statement: End: thank + goodbye, then exactly one close_call(code) as the last tool call. A transfer after a recorded promise uses the transfer code.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Transfer after a recorded promise -> use the transfer code.

extra_rules.statement: Pass customer_id to every tool; 'now' is the current date/time, never the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: customer_id (pass to every tool)

extra_rules.statement: Brief does not give a product_id format or a maximum number of products; max_products 3 is the number of product types.
